exposure: Age group (28-42 weeks of gestation, 5-30 years, 31-60 years)
cohort: The study participants were 63 human cerebellums, comprising 40 from postmortem Bangladeshi cadavers (aged 5-60 years) and 23 from intrauterine death cases delivered via caesarian section (gestational age 34-41 weeks).
finding: The mean length and breadth of the dentate nucleus increased with age up to a certain level before slightly decreasing in the late age Group C, with statistically significant differences observed between specific age groups and sides but not between sexes.
cross-section timing: Specimens were collected from April 2009 to September 2009, with measurements taken at that time.
